# Third-party code

- `fh2mod/`: the FH2 Mod Platform's headers (see `fh2mod/LICENSE`).
- `src/core/bc7.c`: the BC7 block decoder is taken from Pillow's `src/libImaging/BcnDecode.c` (Pillow 11.0.0),
  which states: "The contents of this file are in the public domain (CC0)"
  (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
